name: Light Keeper
summary: A lighthouse on a night cliff: aim its turning beam at lost fishing boats and guide them home
about: A red and white lighthouse stands over a moonlit bay under tonight's real moon phase, its lens turning a 3D beam that sweeps across the water, narrows as it turns away and flares as it swings towards you. Fishing boats drift in with flickering lanterns: catch one in the beam and it lights its green running light and sails into the harbour, or sound the foghorn to warn it off the rocks. Good for a coastal travel site, a calm night-time hero or a cosy game intro.
how: Drag on the sea (or focus the scene and use the left and right arrows) to aim the beam by hand; let go and it turns on its own again.
Hold the beam on a lost boat with a flickering lantern until it pings and turns for the harbour.
Press Foghorn to send rings over the water that steer lost boats away from the rocks.
Toggle Fog to roll in a fog bank, switch the lamp off and on to see it flicker alight, and set how fast it turns.
Light mode shows the bay at blue hour; reduced motion keeps every function with calmer waves and fewer particles.
